paragraphs: Rabbi Chizkiyah Akkayah, in the name of the rabbis of Caesarea: Jerusalem Talmud, Shemonah Sheratzim, halakhah 4. In that matter in Avodah Zarah, chapter Ein Maamidin, halakhah 2, the word Akkayah is absent.
